pages.lesson:
LESSON: PRE READING

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
Strand: READING
Topic 2.1: Pre Reading

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Pre Reading. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: when reading?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

You will learn the key ideas about Pre Reading and use them at home and at school.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

Read about Pre Reading with your parent or teacher. Say what it means in your own words.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Pre Reading.
2. Explain Pre Reading to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: Learners track print through have improved. c) appreciate the finger pointing as the teacher importance of reads Variations to this suggestion should be positioning materials
4. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Pre Reading. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: when reading?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Learners track print through have improved. c) appreciate the finger pointing as the teacher importance of reads Variations to this suggestion should be positioning materials

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Pre Reading is important in everyday life.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
